stage1.impression: A red-and-white milk-carton speaker stands right of centre against a dark teal wainscot, its gable silhouette thrown onto a low warm window patch beside it, and the idea reads at a glance. The product itself reads as a flat, cream-tinted CG box (even front, pinkish side, hard unbevelled edges), the bright patch running off the top-left edge competes with it and the dark foreground floor is dead weight, so it is a competent draft rather than a homepage image.

blocking_9: Front white (front-baffle above the plinth) at median 196-212 and within dE 2.5 of #D9C9B8 (Lab 82/+3/+10, white in warm light); now median 190.0, dE 5.15, Lab 77.1/+5.9/+10.1 (hue 60, salmon), dE 17.8 to #FFFFFF.

Red roof slope carries a lacquer reflection ramp and separates from the fin: band [745,276,931,300] (gable-block) falloff along x +15 to +35; now -20.6, the slope one value (51.4 / 51.4 / 51.0 left of, above and right of the waveguide), the fin 50.0, plus one 81-93 hot spot at the right ridge corner.

Window light closes inside the frame: [310,10,690,70] at shaded-wall level (<= 40), with no glazing-bar shadow crossing the silhouette's patch ([310,290,395,490] p5 >= 100); now that region is 116.3 and the patch runs off the top edge across x 296-705.
Woofer's shaded half holds form: lower-right cone quadrant [835,611,889,666] median 12-32; now 5.5, with 56% of the right half and 70% of the dust cap at <= 3.
Wordmark reads as metal: letters-front-* median 100-140 on the ~45 plinth; now 76.6 (p95 79.3), contrast 1.76:1.

Speaker clears the light patch: its left edge (x 742) at least 80 px from the patch's soft right edge (now x 705, a 37 px near-tangent of two verticals), with the silhouette centred in its patch (margins now 109 px left, 64 px right).

changes.problem: The white front is held below the 200-220 band the card gives for modelling white lacquer, so it prints as a dim beige rather than a white.

evidence.measured: front-baffle pixels above the plinth: median 190.0, p95 206.3; top-to-bottom profile 199.6, 194.8, 191.1, 189.9, 186.9, 179.4, 174.8, 172.9; whole frame mean 52.5 with 57.1% of pixels below 40

changes.problem: The white reads salmon, not white: its hue sits on the red side of orange, and it is pinkest low on the front.

changes.problem: The red roof slope is one flat value, so the lacquered roof reads as matte paper and merges with the fin, because the roof-sheen panel sits where only the slope's right ridge corner can mirror it.

evidence.measured: gable-block: slope left of the waveguide [745,285,775,345] median 51.4 (range 3.4, y-profile 51.4 -> 51.9), above it [775,276,900,292] 51.4, right of it [900,280,930,345] 51.0; fin band 50.0; band [745,276,931,300] x-profile 51.2, 51.2, 51.2, 51.2, 51.3, 51.5, 54.1, 71.8 (falloff -20.6) from one 81-93 hot spot at x 903-930, y ~285. Traced from the camera: the slope's mirror rays meet the panel's plane 0.54-1.03 m from its centre (half-size 0.6), so only that corner sees it

changes.expected: The whole slope mirrors the panel through its existing y-ramp: a diagonal sheen from ~85-95 at the upper left by the fin (rgb ~200/55/50) down to ~56 at the lower-right eave; the fin stays ~55 and reads as its own plane; the corner hot spot goes; band falloff ~+25 to +30; waveguide lip highlights stay below ~180.

changes.problem: The sun patch runs off the top edge for its full width at 5-7x the contrast of the wall around it, so the eye leaves the frame above the silhouette instead of settling on the speaker.

evidence.measured: median 117.2, rgb [146, 112, 83] (a* +9.4, more orange than the 114.6 khaki patch below the rail), range 6.6, unbroken to y 0 between the patch edges at x 296 and 705; shaded upper wall 16.3 at [20,20,270,140] and 23.4 at [740,20,1300,150]

changes.expected: Window head at 2.0 m: the light ends at a slanted head line from about (304, 170) to (697, 90), parallel to today's bar shadow; [310,10,690,70] 116.3 -> ~20-27 (shaded-wall level); the speaker (lit through 0.46-1.51 m of the window), its silhouette, the wainscot patch below the rail and the floor pool keep their light.

changes.problem: With the shorter window (c5) the single glazing bar drops from 1.65 m to 1.2 m, and its shadow would cross the patch at the carton's mid-height (about y 460-485 left of the silhouette, y 390-400 right of it), cutting the silhouette's clean field; this change must go with c5.

evidence.measured: bar shadow traced and seen from (318, 301) to (664, 222), just above the fin's shadow (top y ~300); in this strip p5 61.9 (bar core ~50) against p5 114.7 in clean patch [310,340,395,440]

changes.expected: No bar shadow anywhere in the patch, with the slanted head line from c5 carrying the window read; [310,290,395,490] p5 61.9 -> ~120 (clean patch after c1).

changes.problem: The woofer's shaded half is a black hole: the low sun lights the cone's left wall, while its right half and dust cap mirror the dark floor and crush to black.

evidence.measured: woofer-cone right half median 2.6, 56.2% at <=3 (upper-right quadrant [835,555,889,611] 94.9% at <=3; lower-right [835,611,889,666] median 5.5, 27.2% at <=3); woofer-cap median 2.1, 69.7% at <=3; lit left half median 35.4, p95 189.6. Traced: the lower-right quadrant mirrors open room up and to the left (-0.88, 0.21, 0.42), leaving the cone 0.35 forward of the baffle, so a glint can sit there; the point below projects to (865, 633) on woofer-cone

changes.expected: A soft radial highlight across the lower-right quadrant (median 5.5 -> ~15-25, crush 27% -> under 10%) and a small soft highlight on the dust cap, so the cone reads as metal in shade; the upper-right quadrant stays dark (it mirrors the cone itself); the lit left half unchanged.

changes.problem: The cast-metal wordmark reads as dull grey plastic, with no highlight and little lift off the red.

evidence.measured: letters-front-* median 76.6, p95 79.3, rgb [83, 76, 67] on a plinth of 43.6 (contrast 1.76:1); no kick line shows on the plinth at today's 0.0473 (strip [748,705,785,777] 43.6-56.9)

changes.expected: Letters median ~115 (p95 ~130) with brighter top faces, reading as satin metal; contrast on the ~48 plinth ~2.4:1; plinth red unchanged.

out_of_scope.request: Lift the woofer cone's upper-right quadrant (94.9% of its pixels at <=3) with a lighter or less absorbing cone surface or a shallower cone.
out_of_scope.why: That part of the cone mirrors the cone's own black interior, so no lamp or glint can show in it (a glint there would be skipped); the cone's material and depth are the Dayton RSS315HF-4's own and fixed. A black crescent stays in the largest feature on the front.

out_of_scope.request: A brighter or polished metal for the 'earmilk' letters.
out_of_scope.why: The letters' material is part of the product's finish and fixed; c8 changes only what they reflect, so they will read as satin metal, not bright.
